features.title: Create the FIPS-aligned ML-KEM and ML-DSA operation matrix
features.user_visible_behavior: docs/operation_matrix.md decomposes ML-KEM KeyGen/Encaps/Decaps and ML-DSA KeyGen/Sign/Verify into cited, hardware-relevant primitives without inventing constants.
verification: Confirm every top-level operation is present and each normative constant or operation cites FIPS 203, FIPS 204, or a declared FIPS-aligned source.
Confirm facts and architecture hypotheses are labeled separately.
features.notes: First active M0 feature. Do not begin RTL implementation in this feature.

features.title: Derive the exact arithmetic and encoding width table
features.user_visible_behavior: docs/arithmetic_widths.md records exact coefficient, product, accumulation, reduction, butterfly, encoding, and sampler widths with reproducible derivations and citations.
verification: Check every width has a formula or source reference.
Cross-check ML-KEM q=3329 and ML-DSA q=8380417 paths independently.
Confirm approximate handoff widths were not treated as implementation truth.
features.notes: Starts only after the operation matrix has been reviewed.

features.title: Bring up FIPS-aligned ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA-65 golden models
features.user_visible_behavior: Reproducible scripts run ML-KEM-768 keygen/encaps/decaps and ML-DSA-65 keygen/sign/verify, with deterministic vectors and an intermediate-dump path.
verification: Build trusted FIPS-aligned references from pinned revisions.
Run deterministic ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA-65 round trips.
Record commands, revisions, outputs, and intermediate-dump evidence.
features.notes: Network downloads and dependency installation require explicit user approval.

features.title: Create a normalized reference-architecture comparison
features.user_visible_behavior: docs/reference_architectures.md compares the unified paper, Adams Bridge, PQC OpenTitan, KiD, KaLi, GMUCERG/Dilithium, and HOPE-MLKEM with source-backed PPA and architecture fields plus comparison caveats.
verification: Confirm all required references and comparison columns are present.
Cite the source for every reported metric.
State device, technology, parameter set, and normalization caveats.
features.notes: The KiD paper is stored under docs/references/papers; remaining papers are tracked in docs/references/PAPERS_NEEDED.md.

features.title: Reproduce the existing Mydev_before ML-KEM implementation
features.user_visible_behavior: The legacy ML-KEM design has reproducible per-target Verilator simulations and a Vivado 2024.2 implementation baseline with utilization, timing, latency, and power evidence where supported.
verification: Inventory synthesizable sources, testbenches, top modules, duplicate module names, parameters, vectors, and known-failing directories.
Run each selected target through Verilator lint/simulation before Vivado implementation.
Record Vivado 2024.2 part, constraints, clock, utilization, WNS/TNS, achieved frequency, latency/cycles, and power assumptions.
Keep raw baseline results immutable and distinguish verified behavior from historical claims.
features.notes: Treat Mydev_before as a reusable legacy baseline, not as normative FIPS truth or an optimized final architecture. FPGA part, top-level target, clock target, and XDC still require confirmation.
